sn4.10:2.4: A hundred years was the standard long life (eg. [snp3.8:16.1](), [dn14:3.30.5](), [an7.74:10.3]()).
sn4.10:4.4: This echoes the idea that a wheeled chariot was unstoppable ([sn56.11:12.2]()). Compare too the Upaniṣadic idea that the diverse manifestations of the world rest on the Self, like spokes on a hub (Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 2.5.15, Chāndogya Upaniṣad 7.15.1). But there the application of the metaphor is the oneness of diversity rather than the perpetuation of life.
